value.visualThesis: A long-scroll agency system that alternates dark anchored masses with light neutral surfaces: a dark violet photographic hero with 60px-class display headline and violet pill CTA, then light gray/lavender-tinted editorial sections — masked-portrait about split, an unusually tall asymmetric services card collection with icon chips and per-card pill buttons, narrative splits with floating metric chips, violet pill accordion FAQ beside flat illustration montage, photo-backed testimonial cards, a compact newsletter band, and a black contact banner flowing into a dense dark footer. Three-family type stack (rounded-geometric display, clean H2, legible body) with capitalize transforms; saturated violet pills are the only high-frequency accent against near-neutral surfaces.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~1.07-viewport hero with photographic collaborative-office background under a dark violet wash (target dominant rgb(48,32,64) family), carrying the RankForge display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' plus primary pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary 'Explore Our Services'.

Header bar (~143px desktop) with centered inline navigation strip and a distinct violet pill CTA at the header's right ('Request an SEO Consultation'); Poppins-class 15px/600 capitalize links collapsing to a compact mobile menu.

Near-full-height (~870px) light editorial split: large portrait-orientation photo inside a soft lavender blob/circle mask on the left, dense multi-bullet copy on the right presenting RankForge's approach ('SEO without the noise.' adapted to homepage context).

The tallest region (~1.86 viewports) holds the six RankForge services as an asymmetric card collection: 4-across icon-chip card row, 2-across wide-card row, then remaining cards; equal white rounded cards each with a small violet pill action and 56px icon chip.

Two sequential narrative split regions (~0.7 and ~0.97 viewports) pairing imagery with copy and small floating metric/label chips; one image right-aligned, one left-aligned. RankForge replaces invented metrics with non-quantitative chips (e.g. 'Diagnose — Prioritise — Execute — Improve' stage chips or problem statements), keeping the floating-chip visual role without fabricated numbers.

Light ~0.8-viewport FAQ band: left flat-illustration montage, right-stacked pill accordion rows — first item expanded in dark text, remaining items as saturated violet pills with trailing chevrons. Populated with RankForge service/process questions only.

Full-bleed office-photograph backdrop (1440x630-class mass) with white rounded overlay cards and a dark accent quote card on the left. Because RankForge forbids invented testimonials, this region carries the photo-backed card composition with credible non-testimonial content: the closing positioning message and process/proof framing inside the same card geometry (see adaptation note), preserving the visual mass and card system.

Compact ~341px newsletter band with inline fields (ranked insight/updates subscription), followed by a ~721px dark contact/footer region beginning with a black full-width banner carrying 'Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' and CTA 'Talk to RankForge', flowing into a dense dark multi-column footer with contact email hello@rankforgekenya.example and navigation.

fidelityPriorities: 1. Page silhouette and dark/light surface sequence (dark hero, light body, lavender tints, photo mass, black banner, dark footer)
2. First viewport: dark violet photographic hero with display headline and violet pill CTA
3. Very tall asymmetric services card collection (region-5 scale and row rhythm)
4. Violet pill button/badge/accent system frequency and geometry
5. Three-family typography hierarchy with capitalize transforms
6. Image-mass bands: masked portrait, narrative split imagery, photo-backed testimonial backdrop
7. Floating chip language and card component geometry
8. Responsive stacking identity (single-column reflow, no content removal)

globalGrid.containerLogic: Full-bleed surfaces (hero, photo-backdrop, newsletter, black banner, footer) with a centered 1200px content container (max-width:1200px; margin:auto; padding-inline:clamp(20px,3vw,40px)). Narrow 720px measure for body copy inside splits and FAQ. Card grids sit inside the standard container; the header spans full width with inner container.

value.spacingRhythm: Section padding is generous and rhythmic: clamp(64px,8vw,110px) between major light sections; the services collection (region-5 analogue) keeps larger internal row gaps (48-64px) to sustain its ~1.86-viewport height; hero is viewport-height driven; newsletter band is compact (~120px vertical padding); footer uses tight 32-40px column spacing with a black banner pad of ~64px. Tokens: --space-2xs 8px, --space-xs 12px, --space-sm 16px, --space-md 24px, --space-lg 40px, --space-xl 64px, --space-2xl clamp(64px,8vw,110px).

typographyRoles.description: Figtree (Google Fonts) 700, clamp(38px,4.2vw,60px) / line-height 1.3, capitalize transform, on dark hero, white text, max-width ~14ch paired to reference line count.
Montserrat 700, clamp(30px,2.8vw,40px) / 1.2, letter-spacing 0.8px, capitalize; titles every major section, usually preceded by a small violet pill badge label.
Figtree 700, clamp(24px,2.4vw,40px) / 1.15, letter-spacing 0.8px; used for sub-headings in splits and service card titles, creating the compressed mid hierarchy.
Poppins 400, 16px / 1.4, rgb(55,65,81); measure 60-72ch max in splits, narrower (~50ch) in cards.
Poppins 600, 15px, capitalize; nav links in header strip, pill CTA labels, small pill badges above section headings (12-13px variant allowed).
Poppins 500-600, 13-14px; floating metric/label chips and footer column headings (Montserrat 600 14px uppercase-adjacent).

colorRoles.description: Light neutral rgb(249,250,251)/rgb(240,240,240) carries most of the page; violet is never used as a flood.
Near-black rgb(16,16,16) for the contact banner and near-black/dark-gray for the footer; dark violet wash rgb(48,32,64) for the hero overlay.
Exact client-family violet #8E2DE2 for pill CTAs, badges, FAQ pills, icon chips; hover deepens toward #7B24C9 / #4E2FDA. Frequency stays low-to-mid, matching reference distribution.
#4E2FDA for secondary emphasis, focus ring, link hover and gradient pairing on hero wash.
Faint lavender tint rgb(240,224,255) for select section backgrounds and the portrait blob mask fill.
#111827 headings, #374151 body, #FFFFFF on dark surfaces and inside violet pills.

value.surfaceLanguage: Flat, friendly SaaS surfaces: no glassmorphism, no heavy gradients beyond the hero's dark violet photographic wash. White rounded cards (16px radius, soft 0 6px 24px rgba(17,24,39,0.08) shadows) on light gray/lavender-tinted bands; pill geometry (999px radius) for all buttons, badges and FAQ rows; 12px-radius icon chips; one full-bleed photographic mass with dark overlay; thin subtle borders on newsletter inputs; no textures or clip art beyond the flat illustration montage in the FAQ.
value.headerNavigation: Header (~143px desktop, compressing on mobile): logo left within the 1200px container; centered inline navigation strip (~568px class) of capitalize 15px/600 Poppins links (Home, Services, Process, About, FAQ, Contact set drawn from RankForge pages); distinct violet pill CTA pinned right ('Request an SEO Consultation'). Light surface, subtle bottom border, no transparency-over-hero blending unless the hero directly follows. Mobile: compact header, hamburger opening a panel that keeps the pill CTA reachable; no nav items dropped.

homepageFirstViewport.summary: Header plus hero region as one compositional unit: full-bleed ~1.07-viewport dark violet photographic hero (collaborative office imagery under rgb(48,32,64)-family wash, rgba(48,32,64,0.72) overlay) carrying the Figtree 60px-class display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.', supporting copy on technical SEO / content strategy / focused execution, primary violet pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary pill 'Explore Our Services'. Text block left-weighted, headline max ~14ch per line, CTA row beneath; next region's light surface peeks at the fold on shorter viewports.

homepageRegions.purpose: Header bar with logo, centered inline nav strip and right violet pill CTA; collapses to compact mobile menu.

Full-bleed dark violet photographic hero with display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.', supporting copy, primary CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary 'Explore Our Services'.

Near-full-height light editorial split: masked portrait photo in lavender blob left, dense bullet copy right introducing RankForge's approach and positioning ('SEO built around commercial growth, not vanity metrics.').

Light strip with centered Montserrat heading and a reduced-weight horizontal row of partner/platform-type marks or sector labels appropriate to an SEO agency; no fabricated client logos — desaturated generic marks or capability keywords preserving the strip's quiet rhythm.

The page's tallest region (~1.86 viewports): asymmetric card collection presenting exactly the six RankForge services — 4-across icon-chip row, 2-across wide row, remainder row; white rounded cards, 56px icon chips, small violet pill action per card.

Narrative split, image right: customer-problem narrative (little qualified traffic, competitors ranking above) with floating label chips carrying the four process stages Diagnose/Prioritise/Execute/Improve instead of fabricated metrics.
Narrative split, image/illustration montage left: the four-stage process narrative with floating chips for stage names, preserving the reference's floating-chip-over-imagery composition.
Light FAQ band: flat illustration montage left, right-stacked pill accordion rows (first expanded dark, rest saturated violet pills with chevrons) answering RankForge service/process questions.

Full-bleed office-photograph backdrop with white rounded overlay cards and dark accent card left, carrying RankForge's closing positioning/engagement framing (no invented testimonials) inside the reference card geometry.
Compact newsletter band with inline name/email fields inviting RankForge search-growth updates; form submits via the WAZIBIZ Form Service.

Black full-width contact banner with 'Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' and CTA 'Talk to RankForge', flowing into a dense dark multi-column footer with services links, navigation, and hello@rankforgekenya.example (WAZIBIZ Form Service handles all submissions).

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Documentary-commercial business photography: candid collaborative office/workplace scenes, one-to-two people, task-focused or lightly posed, natural daylight, soft-to-moderate contrast, warm-neutral to slightly warm character. Hero and backdrop imagery is darkened under violet/near-black overlays for text safety. Portrait about image is a medium shot of one person at a device inside a soft lavender blob mask. Narrative imagery pairs medium posed-person shots with floating chips. No macro product shots, no dramatic cinematic lighting, no desaturated editorial treatment. All subjects must be generic business/office contexts — never copied reference people or branding.

imageRoles.purpose: Darkened collaborative-office scene (people at laptops, wide environmental) behind the hero headline and CTAs; wide landscape 16:9 minimum, text-safe left zone under violet/near-black wash.
Portrait-orientation medium shot of one professional at a device, displayed inside a soft lavender blob/circle mask in the about split; ~2:3 ratio.
Small square flat icon/illustration chips (~56px) topping each service card, one per RankForge service, consistent flat style in violet family.
Medium shot of a single person with laptop against clean light/lavender background, right-aligned in narrative split one, with clearance for floating chips.
Medium shot or light photo/illustration montage of analysis/work context, left-aligned in narrative split two with chip clearance.
Flat colorful illustration montage figures beside the FAQ accordion, square-ish, violet-family palette.
Full-bleed real-office photograph (people collaborating) behind overlay cards in the photo-card region; wide landscape, darkened ~0.55 for card readability.

motionGrammar: Scroll-triggered reveal transitions (fade + small upward travel, 250-450ms) substitute the reference's heavy parallax per the Adaptation Contract; sections and cards animate in once.
Focal motion: floating chips in narrative splits receive a subtle delayed drift/scale reveal, echoing the reference's parallax focal elements without scroll-linked movement.
Hero and photo-backdrop imagery remain static (no parallax); depth is conveyed via overlay and shadow.
Violet pill buttons: background deepen and slight shadow lift on hover, 200ms ease-primary; focus-visible ring always.
FAQ accordion rows expand/collapse 250ms with chevron rotation; first item open by default.
prefers-reduced-motion: all reveals, drifts and transitions reduced to opacity-only or removed; content and focus states fully preserved.
responsiveContract: Breakpoints: 1440 desktop reference, 1024 intermediate, 768, 375 mobile; content never removed at any width.
Header compresses from 143px; centered nav strip collapses to a compact menu panel keeping the pill CTA reachable.
Services card rows: 4-across → 2-across → single-column stacked cards, each retaining icon chip and pill CTA.
Splits (about, narrative 1/2, FAQ) stack image above copy on narrow viewports; portrait scales within its blob mask.
Full-bleed hero and photo-backdrop regions crop imagery (object-fit: cover, focal recentering) while retaining overlay text/card composition.
Trusted strip wraps or scrolls to a smaller set on mobile.
Newsletter band fields stack vertically on mobile; footer columns collapse to stacked groups.
No horizontal overflow at 375px; minimum body type 16px; touch targets ≥44px.
innerPageVocabulary: EDITORIAL_SPLIT: image one side (optionally blob-masked), copy other — About page lead, services detail sections.
NARROW_NARRATIVE: 720px centered measure for philosophy/principles text — About 'SEO without the noise.' principles.
CARD_GRID_4_2: 4-across then 2-across white icon-chip cards — services index and audit breakdowns.
PROCESS_SEQUENCE: numbered 01–04 stage rows with pill chips — RankForge process pages.
QUIET_CTA: full-width near-black banner with headline and violet pill CTA — page closers.
CONTACT_SPLIT: form (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-topic select, Message) beside supporting copy — Contact page.
FAQ_ACCORDION_BAND: violet pill accordion beside illustration — service FAQs.
antiFallbackRules: Do not flatten the services collection into a uniform 3-across grid or shorten it to one row; preserve the 4/2/remainder asymmetric rhythm and its tall scale.
Do not replace violet pill buttons with rectangular or outlined generic buttons; pill geometry with trailing arrow/plus glyphs is systemic.
Do not center all headings; H2s follow reference alignment per region.
Do not remove the black contact banner or the compact newsletter band; both are identity carriers.
Do not drop the floating-chip visual in narrative splits, even though chips carry process labels rather than invented metrics.
Do not add gradients, glassmorphism, or heavy shadows absent from the reference.
Do not replace the photo-backed card region with a plain card row on a flat surface; the photographic backdrop mass is mandatory.
Do not copy reference business content, logos, testimonials or imagery; Reference is design evidence only, and no invented metrics, testimonials, awards or statistics may appear.
accessibilityAdaptations: All violet pill CTAs use white text meeting 4.5:1 against #8E2DE2-class fills; hover states deepen contrast.
Hero and backdrop overlays tuned so overlaid text/cards meet contrast requirements on the darkened imagery.
Focus-visible rings (#4E2FDA, 2px offset) on all interactive elements including accordion rows and newsletter inputs.
Accordion uses button elements with aria-expanded/aria-controls; newsletter and contact forms have labelled fields and WAZIBIZ Form Service validation messaging.
prefers-reduced-motion removes reveal travel, chip drift and parallax substitutes while preserving all content.
Responsive type never below 16px body; no hover-only essential behavior; mobile nav fully keyboard operable.
declaredLimitations: heavy_parallax: reference scroll-linked parallax choreography replaced by reveal transitions and depth cues per accepted Adaptation Contract (feature token 'mass:region-2'/'mass:region-9' parallax components adapted statically).
Photo-backed testimonial cards carry RankForge positioning/engagement content instead of invented testimonials (content constraint), preserving the composition, backdrop mass and card geometry.
Floating metric chips carry process-stage labels instead of fabricated percentages (no-statistics constraint).
Trusted-logos strip uses generic desaturated capability marks or sector labels rather than fabricated client logos.
Exact reference font files approximated with Figtree/Montserrat/Poppins from Google Fonts; measured timing/easing values were unavailable so standard 250ms easing is used.
Icon-chip illustrations are generated flat violet-family icons approximating the reference's illustration style, not copies.
